about.about-sub: Get to know me a little more.
about.about2-text: I am a Systems and Informatics Engineering graduate, specializing in software development and process optimization. My academic background, recognized with an Excellence Scholarship on three occasions, has served as the foundation for developing functional and efficient solutions, with a focus on both web and desktop environments.

projects.projects-subtitle: These are some of the projects I have developed.
projects.vri-desc: Official portal of the Vice-Rectorate of Research at the National University of Piura, designed to showcase scientific output and institutional progress.
projects.project2-desc: Comprehensive web system for administrative and academic management: tracking incoming and outgoing documents, institutional calendar, and end-to-end thesis workflow control (metadata, advisor assignments, review observations, corrections, and report exports).
projects.project1-desc: Designed to promote responsible pet adoption, facilitate donations, and provide animal care information in Piura.
projects.project4-desc: Platform developed to provide information about the institution, featuring an administrative panel for efficient management.
projects.project5-desc: Real-time currency converter with updated exchange rates and an intuitive interface.
projects.project6-desc: Portal created to centralize and share relevant faculty information, connecting students and professors.
